attributes.action: Air conditioning for all public spaces, schools Closure in a heatwave
attributes.additional_details: Closure of all schools and businesses due to a heat wave in the UK, with no air conditioning in rooms where people have to work and children who attend school.
attributes.background: If the building has no air conditioning in all spaces, it should not open in a heatwave, such as schools, colleges, and places of employment, including public transport. This government needs to ensure the safety of all.

rejection.details:
